Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking a look at Redwood. Would love to get a short initial discovery on the calendar (30–45 min) so we can:

- Walk through your current infra (on-prem + cloud mix)
- Surface any security/compliance blockers for Private deployment

Attaching a 1‑page agenda and our vendor security intake checklist to make the call efficient. Could you confirm who from your side should join (engineering lead + procurement/security)? My default ask is: your champion + engineering lead + procurement if they want procurement-level terms.

- Tue 5/4: 09:00–09:45, 11:00–11:45

Diego (SE) will join to run the technical intake. Karthik (AE lead) is copied in case we need to loop in procurement or legal.

If none of those work, send a couple of 30‑minute options and we’ll match.

Thanks —
